command: npx vitest run <the test files of the mutant's source file> --reporter=json --outputFile=<scratch>/mutation-<id>.json
method: Each mutant replaces one fragment (asserted to occur exactly once) in its file, runs the test files listed for that file under vitest with the JSON reporter, and restores every source in finally. A mutant is killed when the run exits non-zero and at least one test fails (failedTests lists each) or is stopped after 600 s; a run that exits non-zero with no failed test and no timeout is recorded as not run, never as killed. The unmutated baseline of each group runs first and must pass.

equivalent.reason: Both callers that can hand deriveFindings a v17 draft strip its levels first (check.ts and render.ts, each `doc = withoutLevels(withoutWalks(doc))` before the call; the mutants check-level-findings-dropped and render-levels-not-passed show both paths run), and the third caller, verify-text.ts, passes a synthetic subject with no diagrams. The strip inside deriveFindings is the documented contract for any later caller, not reachable today.

levelFieldVersionPaths and levelFieldVersionFindings are read only inside deriveFindings, which reads the draft after withoutLevels; in a v17 draft that removes every `level` and `scope`, so with the version arm gone the functions still find no member to report.

Design D8's "put the layer on a 1048 px drawing". No drawing the readable layout draws through an operator-agent dossier is 1048 px wide: it stacks every graph figure into a column (the R88 record's equivalent `width-guard-deleted`, the same guard, which a zoom-only layer now shares). `walkableWidth` itself is pinned at 1047, 1048 and 1049 by dossier-walk.test.ts.
A containment drawing is 40 + 184 n px wide for its one to five top-level groups (diagram-layout.ts `figureWidth`), at most 960 px, so no containment is 1048 px wide and the guard never fails.

equivalent.old: const zoom = isBase(n.id) ? undefined : zoomOf(from, n.id, index);
equivalent.reason: A base node's identity is a fact identity, which starts with `_` (derived-base.ts), while a zoom target is keyed by a `scope`, a model element's identity, which check resolves against the model alone and which the identity schema never lets start with `_`; so `zoomOf` finds no target for a base node either way.

The guard refuses a render whose zoom target the inertness check turned into a notice. A checked draft's labels pass label-markup and the drawing is built from escaped text only, so assertInertSvg never refuses a checked figure, and no test can reach the guard through the pipeline.
